summary_en: Minimum purchase threshold reduced from 19,226,700 to 15,988,500 shares (55.73% of S/O ex-treasury); price ¥1,580/share unchanged; acquisition period extended to Aug 3, 2026 (55 business days); target (Shinkō Shoji, code 8141) board recommends acceptance; purpose remains complete subsidiary acquisition by KAGA Electronics.
title_en: Notice of Changes to Tender Offer Terms and Conditions for Ordinary Shares of Shinkō Shoji Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 8141)
translation_en_brief: KAGA Electronics announced on July 17, 2026 an amendment to its public tender offer for Shinkō Shoji Co., Ltd. (TSE Prime, code 8141). The minimum purchase threshold has been lowered from 19,226,700 shares (64.93% of S/O) to 15,988,500 shares (55.73% post-acquisition, computed on an ex-treasury basis of 29,612,599 shares outstanding as of March 31, 2026). The tender price remains ¥1,580 per share. No upper limit is set; if minimum is reached, KAGA will acquire all tendered shares to achieve complete subsidiary status. The acquisition period, originally May 18 – July 29, 2026 (52 business days), is extended to August 3, 2026 (55 business days) to accommodate filing of the amended tender offer statement. Shinkō Shoji's board recommends participation. The reduction in the minimum threshold reflects revised capital-structure assumptions but does not alter KAGA's stated intent to obtain 100% ownership.
